decisive_spans.text: EUS-guided FNA of an oval, hypoechoic posterior mediastinal lesion (68 × 70 mm) obtained a core biopsy that demonstrated a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Immunohistochemical staining was positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
Somatic genetic analysis of cKIT and PDGFRA revealed no mutations, and germline testing was positive for NF1, suggesting wild-type GIST

response.rationale: The vignette provides strong evidence for Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) through histological findings (spindle cell neoplasm), immunohistochemistry (positive for CD117, DOG1), and genetic testing (NF1 positivity suggesting wild-type GIST). While NF1 is present, GIST is the specific tumor identified.
